total_model.summary: Model projects 47.4 total points (KC 29, NYJ 18). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.5), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 1.2), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
